courses_research_notes: NEUST is a multi-campus SUC; programs aggregated from official campus pages and admission portal. Sumacab hosts flagship Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Criminology, and ICT. Gabaldon hosts Agriculture and rural education. Gen. Tinio hosts Nursing and Industrial Technology majors. Additional campuses (San Isidro, Atate, Fort Magsaysay) offer overlapping Business/IT/Education programs. Data Science and Public Administration also listed at Sumacab.
